reviewer: Project review after the browser verdict, written with Claude Code (the AI assistant that built this project). A reading of the patch, not another test.
verdict: Rejected on review: hangs at maxDate
summary: Arrow keys now step past days that minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends or disableDayFn close, instead of selecting them.
caveats: At a range boundary the do…while loop never finds an allowed date: with a maxDate set, ArrowRight on that day hung the page in Chromium, while the unpatched library stayed on the day.
The stricter case pikaday-keyboard-disabled-day-max-date adds a maxDate and a guard. This patch fails it, while the three earlier model patches for this bug pass it.
It keeps Pikaday’s own 24-hour millisecond steps, which can land on the wrong day across a daylight-saving change (a separate flaw that the original adjustDate shares).
